summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K to update its at-the-market offering program and bitcoin holdings. During June 1–7, 2026, it sold 1,409,600 shares of Class A common stock for net proceeds of $181 million, with remaining capacity of $25.96 billion across various securities. It also acquired 1,550 BTC for $101.3 million at an average price of $65,332, bringing total holdings to 845,256 BTC at a $63.97 billion aggregate purchase price. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation event, management change, or strategic transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed. Watch for continued ATM usage and bitcoin accumulation pace.
